episodes.title: TheQuartering’s K Cup Crisis PR & Crying Victim After Starting War with Kino Casino (Jul 14, 2026)
episodes.summary: A clip of TheQuartering defending his coffee business against claims that it is dropshipping. He explains his supplier, roasting, flavour development, fulfilment and K-Cup arrangements; says critics contacted and visited business partners; and frames the scrutiny as harassment. The clip is his response and does not independently verify either side.

episodes.title: Professional Streamer TheQuartering - Gooners Gonna Goon (Jul 14, 2026)
episodes.summary: A short multi-host TheQuartering stream discussing sports-camera rules, sexualisation and personal responsibility, followed by business talk about a proposed Walmart coffee listing. The stream then includes a racially discriminatory hiring anecdote and closes early for a business meeting.

episodes.title: TheQuartering: Friday Night Tights is a Huge Pword for Firing Chrissie Mayr (Jul 13, 2026)
episodes.summary: TheQuartering reacts to Chrissie Mayr no longer appearing on Friday Night Tights. He repeatedly states that he does not know the internal arrangement, but says it looks as though FNT removed her after her Melanie Mack interview and condemns the show for yielding to hostile chatters or superchat pressure.
